jobs.name: mage
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art sprite sheet for a cozy fantasy potion-shop game. Draw ONE newly designed full-body character in exactly SIX separate complete poses, organized in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid of equal-size cells, transparent background. Pixel-art style: compact chibi proportions approximately 48x64 native sprite pixels, crisp square pixels, dark outlines, limited warm palette, no antialiasing, no gradients, no labels, no grid marks, no shadows on the ground. All six poses same character, same costume, same proportions and scale, three-quarter side view FACING LEFT, head height and foot baseline aligned, ample transparent margins. Each pose is drawn as a complete coordinated body with arms, torso, clothing and legs animated together. Exact row-major cell order: top-left IDLE standing; top-middle WALK A CONTACT: anatomical LEFT/near leg (bright) extended toward screen-left and anatomical RIGHT/far leg (dark) extended toward screen-right, opposite arm forward; top-right WALK A PASSING: LEFT/near foot planted beneath pelvis, RIGHT/far knee lifted and passing forward. Bottom-left WALK B CONTACT: anatomical RIGHT/far leg (dark) extended toward screen-left and anatomical LEFT/near leg (bright) extended toward screen-right, opposite arm forward; bottom-middle WALK B PASSING: RIGHT/far foot planted beneath pelvis, LEFT/near knee lifted and passing forward; bottom-right PURCHASE COMPLETE friendly smile with an empty hand extended. Critical animation constraint: walking A and B must visibly use OPPOSITE anatomical legs; do not merely change stride width or mirror the whole character. The near leg remains the brighter leg in every frame, the far leg remains darker in every frame, so this identity visibly crosses between front and back. Coordinated modest arm counter-swing and body weight shift, stable head, consistent hair, accessories and garment design. No extra characters, no cropped body parts, no composited or replaced lower legs, no text.
Subject: A female fantasy mage with a large floppy pointed dark-purple hat, dark-purple shoulder-length hair, a short layered purple robe with a gold brooch, dark stockings and ankle boots. Redesign the whole character as coherent new full-body art, retaining only these recognizable theme cues.
Character is an adult woman with stylized RPG proportions. Let both knees and boots remain clearly visible below the short robe so alternating feet can be read.

Top-right: WALK A with anatomical NEAR LEFT leg extended toward screen-left and anatomical FAR RIGHT leg extended toward screen-right. Move arms, shoulders, hips, skirt and hair together naturally for each opposite step. Both legs visible below tunic. Whole bodies newly drawn, no old upper body pasted onto legs. Design readable when reduced to 48x64 sprites, ample transparent cell margins.
